DESCRIBE.template:
DESCRIBE rtsp_uri RTSP/1.0
CSeq: <sequence_number>
Accept: application/sdp
[Session: <session_id>]

examples: integer, in response; length of SDP body
string, in response; indicates body type (e.g., application/sdp)
string, optional; not required before SETUP
string, the URI of the presentation
string, mandatory; current active session ID
string, optional in OPTIONS; present if session exists
string, the URI of the resource being queried

PAUSE.template:
PAUSE rtsp_uri RTSP/1.0
CSeq: <sequence_number>
Session: <session_id>
Range: <range_value>

examples: string, optional; point in time to pause at
string, mandatory; current active session ID

PLAY.template:
PLAY rtsp_uri RTSP/1.0
CSeq: <sequence_number>
Session: <session_id>
Range: <range_value>
[Scale: <scale_value>]

examples: string, optional; start/stop times for playback
string, mandatory; current active session ID

SETUP.template:
SETUP rtsp_uri RTSP/1.0
CSeq: <sequence_number>
Session: <session_id>
Transport: <transport_params>
[Range: <range_value>]

examples: string, optional; NPT or clock range
string, mandatory; assigned by server after previous SETUP or initial session
string, mandatory; specifies RTP/UDP, RTP/TCP, etc., with client ports
string, track-specific URI for stream setup

SET_PARAMETER.template:
SET_PARAMETER rtsp_uri RTSP/1.0
CSeq: <sequence_number>
Session: <session_id>
Content-Type: <content_type>
Content-Length: <length>

<body>

examples: string, mandatory; current active session ID
string, mandatory; current active session ID
